header.route: draft: no Performance Max campaign has ever existed in this account, so there is nothing to review yet

scorecard.why: Calls, contact forms, live chat and call-or-text are counted, so PMax has a goal to learn from.

scorecard.key_number: 62.0 conversions in 30 days on Criminal Defense
scorecard.why: Criminal Defense has the most conversions of the 9 Search campaigns, so it is the offer for the draft (no offer was named).
Leads carry no value, so the draft must bid on conversions: create sets Maximize Conversion Value, and a follow-up switches it to Maximize Conversions.

scorecard.key_number: 1 brand Search campaign (20.4 conversions in 30 days)
scorecard.why: Add brand exclusions to the PMax campaign in Google Ads before it goes live, or PMax can bid on searches the Brand campaign already wins.

scorecard.key_number: 4 images: 0 landscape, 2 square, 0 portrait usable; 2 logo candidates
scorecard.why: No landscape image at 600x314 or larger, which Performance Max requires. The two square images can serve, and one of them may be the logo; the API does not label logos, so the user must say which.

scorecard.key_number: 6 open lists, largest 8 members; 2 audiences, both income segments
scorecard.why: No customer or site-visitor list reaches 1,000 members and the only audiences are demographic, so the draft starts on search themes alone.

scorecard.key_number: 1 positive location (one US state), matching PRESENCE
scorecard.why: The create action takes country codes only, so the draft is created for US and a follow-up adds the state and removes US before anything goes live.
Text is complete (15 headlines, 2 long headlines, 4 descriptions); images are not.
Themes come from converting search terms, with the brand term dropped; there is no usable audience list yet.

diagnosis.primary_issue: The account is ready for Performance Max on tracking and volume, but not on creative: there is no landscape image, so the draft cannot be created yet.
chain: Symptom (section 8, pre-launch review): the draft fails MARKETING_IMAGE (0 of 1 required).
Cause (section 8, R5): the account's 4 images are all square, too small or off-ratio.
Root (section 3, coverage table): PMax requires at least one landscape image, one square image and a logo in every asset group, so the firm has to supply landscape images before anything is created.

top_fixes.fix: Supply at least one landscape image (1.91:1, 1200x628 ideal, 600x314 minimum); 4 is the aim
top_fixes.evidence: R5 and pre-launch coverage: 4 images, sizes 32x32, 483x483, 483x659, 1200x1200
top_fixes.note: then I can add it to the draft

top_fixes.fix: Say which square image is the logo
top_fixes.evidence: 2 square images at 128x128 or larger; the API does not label logos

top_fixes.fix: Add brand exclusions to the new campaign before it goes live
top_fixes.evidence: R4: the Brand campaign had 20.4 conversions in 30 days
top_fixes.note: before the campaign is enabled; there is no MCP action for brand exclusions

top_fixes.fix: After create: switch bidding to Maximize Conversions with a $19 target CPA, and swap US for the state
top_fixes.evidence: R3: conversion value 0; R7: 1 positive state location
top_fixes.note: right after the create succeeds, and only after you confirm each payload

top_fixes.fix: Build a site-visitor list on the main site (1,000+ members) and add it as an audience signal
top_fixes.evidence: R6: largest open list has 8 members; audiences are income segments only
top_fixes.note: once the list reaches 1,000 members, I can add it with update_asset_group_signals
